name: DBpedia Companies Subset (10k Companies)
description: Subset of the DBpedia knowledge base describing approximately 10,000 companies. For each company, the dataset includes information about the founding date and place, the industry, the founders, as well as numerical attributes such as income, revenue, and assets. The DBpedia knowledge base been automatically extracted from Wikipedia. The dataset has been created by query the DBpedia SPARQL endpoint.

variableMeasured.name: entity_uri
variableMeasured.description: DBpedia resource URI identifying the company

variableMeasured.name: org_name
variableMeasured.description: Official or common name of the company

variableMeasured.name: established
variableMeasured.description: Date or year in which the company was founded

variableMeasured.name: sector
variableMeasured.description: Industry or business sector in which the company operates

variableMeasured.name: keypeople_name
variableMeasured.description: Key person associated with the company
